mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule (class_id, course_name, teacher_name, day_of_week, time_slot, classroom) VALUES (#{classId}, #{courseName}, #{teacherName}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{timeSlot}, #{classroom})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.class_id, c.class_name, s.course_name, s.teacher_name, s.day_of_week, s.time_slot, s.classroom, s.create_time, s.update_time, s.is_deleted FROM schedule s LEFT JOIN `class` c ON s.class_id = c.id AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.is_deleted = 0

SELECT s.id, s.class_id, c.class_name, s.course_name, s.teacher_name, s.day_of_week, s.time_slot, s.classroom, s.create_time, s.update_time, s.is_deleted FROM schedule s LEFT JOIN `class` c ON s.class_id = c.id AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.class_id = #{classId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.day_of_week, s.time_slot
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule SET course_name = #{courseName}, teacher_name = #{teacherName}, day_of_week = #{dayOfWeek}, time_slot = #{timeSlot}, classroom = #{classroom} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
